relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 inflammasome activation releases IL-1β, which promotes the development of Th17 cells

relationships.subject: MCC950
relationships.evidence_quote: MCC950 suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome, lowers IL-1β, and reduces inflammation in EAP mice

relationships.subject: NSC74859
relationships.evidence_quote: the inhibitor suppressed the shift of Treg to Th17

key_findings: NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1β are elevated in EAP prostate; MCC950 reduced IL-1β, Th17 and 17+Treg cells and pelvic pain responses.
IL-1β promotes Th17 differentiation and Treg-to-Th17 conversion, associated with enhanced STAT3 phosphorylation.
